scripts.build: pnpm build:probe && node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:probe && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts check
scripts.test: pnpm test:voice-runtime && pnpm test:model-list && pnpm test:build-env && pnpm build:probe && node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts test
scripts.test:voice-runtime: node --import tsx -e 'Promise.all([import("./tests/voice-runtime-cases.ts"), import("./tests/voice-wake-cases.ts"), import("./tests/voice-openai-cases.ts"), import("./tests/voice-async-task-cases.ts"), import("./tests/body-runtime-cases.ts")]).then(async ([voice, wake, openai, asyncTask, body]) => { await voice.verifyVoiceRuntime(); await wake.verifyWakeRuntime(); await openai.verifyOpenAiVoiceRuntime(); await openai.verifyVoiceTraceFinalization(); await asyncTask.verifyAsyncVoiceTasks(); await body.verifyBodyRuntime(); })'
scripts.test:ios: pnpm build:probe && node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts probe-ios
scripts.test:android: pnpm build:probe && node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts probe-android
scripts.ios:faces: node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts run --target ios FaceProbe.tsx
scripts.test:ui:ios: pnpm build:probe && node --import tsx scripts/nsh.ts ui-ios
